verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page documents progress reporting such as burn down charts and cycle-time measurement, plus visibility into progress toward priorities. That is first-party reporting on project progress, but the pack never mentions building configurable dashboards or adding widgets or gadgets. Missing for 10: documented customizable dashboards, a widget/gadget library and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of dashboard reporting.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress

citations.quote: Keep work on track whether you're measuring engineering cycle time, burn down charts, or managing capacity.
Get visibility on your company's progress towards top priorities as projects advance
